This repository is HagopJay's working fork of the Blender extension Web3D X3D/VRML2 format
Its purpose is to bring the exporter and importer up to X3D 4.0 (ISO/IEC 19775-1:2023) so Blender can trade physically based scenes with X3D 4 browsers
so Blender can trade physically based scenes with X3D 4 browsers (X_ITE, X3DOM, Castle, FreeWRL)

Principled BSDF → PhysicalMaterial (baseColor, metallic, roughness, emissiveColor, transparency, normalScale, occlusionStrength)
X3D 4.1 draft (GaussianSplats) | Everything the 4.0 option writes, plus Gaussian-splat objects as the draft GaussianSplats node
